planned_argument_object.prompt:
COMPLETE ORIGINAL USER REQUEST (literal):
덕테이프 포스터를 만들어줘. 문구는 “서로 다른 속도”만 넣어줘. 어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게.

ALL LITERAL COPY ENTRIES:
[
  {
    "text": "서로 다른 속도",
    "kind": "text",
    "fixed_newlines": false
  }
]

COMMON USER CONDITIONS / STYLES / RATIOS:
{
  "conditions": [
    "Print the supplied title once with intact readable Hangul; no other copy, logos, labels or watermarks.",
    "Each output is a separate single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3.",
    "All five must have a substantive content-grounded non-glyph visual concept. Type/whitespace-only or tiny ornament, backgroundtexture/gradient/wallpaper, or3Dlettering-alone loopholes are prohibited.",
    "Styles are open; subject relationships, typography and spatial organization must distinguish all five, not color/filter variants."
  ],
  "styles": {
    "mode": "open",
    "exact_request": "어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게."
  },
  "ratios": [
    "2:3",
    "2:3",
    "2:3",
    "2:3",
    "2:3"
  ]
}

COMMON COORDINATOR CONSTRAINTS:
[
  "Print the supplied title exactly once, with intact readable Hangul and the original word spacing. Line breaks may occur between whole words. The directions are internal guidance and must not be printed.",
  "No other copy, supporting text, labels, numbers, logos, series identifiers, style names or watermarks. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces must be unbranded and free of incidental text.",
  "Each assigned maker produces only its own independent, single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3. No panels, contact sheets, poster mockups or borrowing another maker's generated image as a reference.",
  "The substantial non-glyph relation must remain recognizable with the title hidden and at reduced viewing size. Tiny ornament, wallpaper, background texture, gradients and 3D lettering alone do not satisfy it.",
  "Preserve the assigned relation and distinction while solving practical crop, proportion, palette, alignment and title placement independently. There is no shared title-object-footer layout or common allocation of image and copy area.",
  "Downstream native-tool production must request the maximum resolution supported by the current tool and model while preserving 2:3; verify the actual returned dimensions and readable copy after generation."
]

DESIGN SPEC — one independent, single flat opaque portrait poster, width:height 2:3.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

Create an expressive two-ink relief-cut botanical poster. Its entire image is one continuous living structure, conveying growth proceeding at unequal speeds within a connected system. On a quiet, fully opaque pale warm-yellow ground, draw exactly two above-ground shoots of the SAME broadleaf plant species, emerging from a thick, clearly connected horizontal rootstock. One tall, slightly curving shoot rises on the left, with three or four paired, fully opened pointed-oval leaves and a small folded tip. On the right a much shorter emerging shoot rises to less than one third of the tall shoot's height, with a pair of recognizably FOLDED developing leaves. Keep their leaf outlines, midrib anatomy, stem character and ink logic consistent. No flowers, seed capsules, pots, decorative suns, landscape, frames or unrelated specimens.

A substantial exposed root network occupies the lower third, visibly branching downward from the common rootstock and from both stem junctions. The rootstock must be visibly continuous from the tall shoot to the short one; avoid two disconnected root balls or a forest of extra seedlings. Branch thick primary roots into finer tapered secondary roots; make botanical connections intelligible and traceable at reduced size. Foliage, directional stem cuts and branching root contours are the principal composition, rather than wallpaper or background ornament.

Use deep nearly-black forest-green ink for stems, solid foliage, and the substantial tapering roots. In the foliage, use only a few restrained carved vein slits aligned with the actual growth. Let edges have small controlled cutting irregularities that follow the direction of leaf or root. Do not add grain or scratches across the whole paper. No photorealism, shadows or 3D lighting. The drawn form should have emphatic, uneven organic ascent, with the large developed shoot carrying the upper-left weight and the short folded shoot making visibly more open space above it at right.

Title: print the supplied Hangul once only, as one robust hand-drawn word group in dark burnt-orange ink, horizontal reading, around the soil/branching boundary, between the unequal growth above and connected exposed roots below. Arrange the three whole words on ONE LINE if they fit with broad square syllables; otherwise wrap only between whole words. Prefer one line across the middle at roughly 57–62% of the poster height. The title should sit in the pale pocket directly ABOVE the rootstock and between the two stems, enclosed by the unequal botanical structure, not isolated in a generic top header or bottom footer. Let the two stem bases flank the word group with clear separation from every glyph; the connected rootstock runs below with breathing space. Do not draw a box or banner behind the text.

Make each syllable intact and easily readable, with strong consistent stroke weight, generous counters, proper Hangul component proportions, stable baselines and original visible word spaces. Do not stretch or squeeze the syllables to fill width. Controlled hand-drawn ends should echo the carved plant marks without breaking or merging character strokes. No leaf, stem or root may become a letter stroke or overlap any copy. The three words have modest optical spacing, distinctly wider than inter-syllable spacing. Only the literal copy entry is printed; all directions and prompt labels remain invisible.

The first glance must read as a large and a very small shoot connected to the same branching root system; the title then becomes the grounded hinge between emergence and roots. Keep all required glyphs and the two shoots inside the canvas, with enough margin around tall leaves and lower root ends. A single flat, edge-to-edge opaque poster only. No panels, contact sheet, mockup, border photograph, lettering-only result, incidental text, logos, numbers, labels or watermarks.
